'''Alberto Carpinteri''' (born 23 December 1952) is an Italian engineer and physicist known for his contributions to [[fracture mechanics]], [[structural engineering]], and [[materials science]].<ref name=":3">{{cite journal|author =Emiliano Feresin |url=http://www.nature.com/news/italian-scientists-win-battle-to-halt-controversial-research-1.10823 |title=Italian scientists win battle to halt controversial research : Nature News & Comment |journal=Nature |date=13 June 2012 |doi=10.1038/nature.2012.10823 |s2cid=156565051 |access-date=26 November 2012|url-access=subscription }}</ref> His research has focused on the mechanics of solids and structures, structural integrity, and crack propagation phenomena in quasi-brittle materials. He has held senior academic and leadership positions in Italy and internationally and is currently Chang Jiang (Blue River) Chair Professor of Civil Engineering at [[Shantou University]], China.

== Education ==
Carpinteri earned a doctoral degree in [[Nuclear Engineering]] from the [[University of Bologna]] in 1976, graduating ''cum laude''. He subsequently completed a second doctoral degree in [[Mathematics]] at the same university in 1981, also ''cum laude''.

==Career==
Carpinteri began his academic career as a researcher in the Nuclear Power Plants Programme of the [[National Research Council (Italy)|Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche]] (CNR) in [[Bologna]], later also serving as an assistant professor at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Alberto Carpinteri - Biography |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Carpinteri_Alberto/CV |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

In 1986, he joined the [[Polytechnic University of Turin|Politecnico di Torino]], where he was appointed Chair Professor of the Mechanics of Solids and Structures, a position he held until 2023. During his tenure at Politecnico di Torino, he served in several academic leadership roles, including Head of the Department of Structural Engineering, Director of the “A. Castigliano” Fracture Mechanics Laboratory, and Founding Director of the Doctoral School of Structural Engineering.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bellini |first=Ezio |date=2022-12-13 |title=ALBERTO CARPINTERI PROFESSORE DEL POLITECNICO DI TORINO E SOCIO CDT RICEVE RICONOSCIMENTO INTERNAZIONALE |url=https://clubcdt.it/alberto-carpinteri-professore-del-politecnico-di-torino-e-socio-cdt-riceve-riconoscimento-internazionale/ |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=CDT - Club Dirigenti Tecnici |language=it-IT}}</ref>

In addition to his academic appointments, Carpinteri held leadership roles within Italy’s national research system. He served as President and previously Deputy President of the National Research Institute of Metrology (INRIM) in Turin.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2023-10-17|title=Homepage {{!}} INRIM|url=https://www.inrim.it/it|website=www.inrim.it}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

In 2013, INRIM was placed under temporary receivership following the resignation of a majority of its board members. In this context, Carpinteri was dismissed from his position.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.inrim.it/gen/organi_i.shtml |title=INRIM – l'Istituto |access-date=23 September 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131030194539/http://www.inrim.it/gen/organi_i.shtml |archive-date=30 October 2013 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.inrim.it/gen/doc/DPCM_14_febbraio_2013_Commissariamento_INRIM.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=23 September 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140506200720/http://www.inrim.it/gen/doc/DPCM_14_febbraio_2013_Commissariamento_INRIM.pdf |archive-date=6 May 2014 |url-status=dead }}</ref> The episode was associated with internal institutional disputes, including disagreement over his public support for research related to so-called ''[[Post Irradiation Examination|piezonuclear]]'' phenomena.<ref name=":3" />

Carpinteri has held numerous leadership positions in international scientific and professional organizations. He served as President of the [[International Congress on Fracture]] (ICF),<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2023-10-17|language=en-US|title=Past Presidents – ICF|url=https://www.icfweb.org/site/?page_id=1318}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> the [[European Structural Integrity Society]] (ESIS), the International Association of Fracture Mechanics for Concrete and Concrete Structures (IA-FraMCoS),<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2023-10-17|title=FRaMCoS Snapshot|url=https://framcos.org/framcos-summary.php|website=framcos.org}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> and the Italian Group of Fracture (IGF).<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2023-10-17|language=it|title=IGF - Former IGF Presidents|url=https://www.gruppofrattura.eu/about-us/former-igf-presidents|website=www.gruppofrattura.eu}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> He was also the Head of the Engineering Division in the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts|European Academy of Sciences]] (EurASc).<ref name=":0" /> He was a member of the Executive Committee of the [[International Union of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics]] (IUTAM) from 2004 to 2012 and served on the executive board of the [[Society for Experimental Mechanics]] (SEM) from 2012 to 2014.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Alberto Carpinteri-汕头大学工学院 |url=https://eng.stu.edu.cn/info/1085/3252.htm |access-date=2026-02-19 |website=eng.stu.edu.cn}}</ref>

Carpinteri also served as Editor-in-Chief of ''Meccanica'', an international journal of [[Springer Nature]] covering theoretical and applied mechanics, and has been a member of editorial boards of several international journals in mechanics and structural engineering.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Carpinteri |first=Alberto |date=2012-01-01 |title=Editorial |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/s11012-011-9531-0 |journal=Meccanica |language=en |volume=47 |issue=1 |pages=1–1 |doi=10.1007/s11012-011-9531-0 |issn=1572-9648}}</ref>

== Research ==
Carpinteri’s research has primarily addressed [[fracture mechanics]], structural integrity, and the mechanical behavior of materials and structures.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Carpinteri |first=Alberto |date=2021 |title=Fracture and Complexity |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-94-024-2026-5?error=cookies_not_supported&code=361b2000-448a-4e77-8a17-61b036b64d56 |journal=Solid Mechanics and Its Applications |doi=10.1007/978-94-024-2026-5 |issn=0925-0042|url-access=subscription }}</ref> His work has contributed to the understanding of crack initiation and propagation, size-scale effects on structural [[brittleness]] and material properties, plasticity, and instability phenomena in solids, with applications to concrete, masonry, and composite materials.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Carpinteri |first=A. |last2=Carmona |first2=J. R. |last3=Ventura |first3=G. |date=2007 |title=Propagation of flexural and shear cracks through reinforced concrete beams by the bridged crack model |url=http://www.emerald.com/jmacr/article/59/10/743-756/410018 |journal=Magazine of Concrete Research |language=en |volume=59 |issue=10 |pages=743–756 |doi=10.1680/macr.2007.59.10.743 |issn=0024-9831|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

In later phases of his career, he also investigated anomalous energy-release phenomena in solids subjected to mechanical stress, a line of inquiry sometimes described as condensed matter nuclear science.<ref>{{cite web|title=Clean Energy from Hydrogen-Metal Systems|url=https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/951974/it}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|title=CleanHME - Clean Energy from Hydrogen-Metal Systems - Politecnico di Torino|url=https://www.polito.it/ricerca/una-ricerca-integrata/anagrafe-della-ricerca?progetto=1212/2020}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

He has supervised 35 doctoral dissertations and over 120 master’s theses. Many of his former students have gone on to academic or research careers in Italy and abroad. Carpinteri has authored over 450 peer-reviewed scientific journal articles, 18 books,<ref>{{cite web|title=Alberto Carpinteri - Politecnico di Torino|url=https://www.polito.it/personale?p=001650}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Pubblicazioni Alberto Carpinteri su ResearchGate|url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Alberto-Carpinteri-39196492}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> and numerous invited papers and keynote lectures.<ref>{{cite web|title=Curriculum Vitae Prof. Albero Carpinteri|url=https://staff.polito.it/alberto.carpinteri/cv/CARPINTERI_ExtendedCV%201.pdf|access-date=2 November 2023|archive-date=2 November 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231102100108/https://staff.polito.it/alberto.carpinteri/cv/CARPINTERI_ExtendedCV%201.pdf|url-status=dead}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Distinguished Lecture in Solid Mechanics - CalTech - Alberto Carpinteri|url=https://www.caltech.edu/campus-life-events/calendar/distinguished-lecture-in-solid-mechanics}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>
